messages:
maria: Filing this here — ticket #4521. Customer started seeing a schema shift after we switched the hosted default model to redwood/mistral-lite-7b-v2 yesterday. Intermittent (~12%) responses are missing the expected 'items' array and return a top-level 'results' key instead. Repro and samples below.

josh: can you paste a minimal curl repro? :eyes:

maria: sure, minimal request the customer used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/mistral-lite-7b-v2","input":"List items as JSON","response_format":{"type":"json_schema","schema":{"items":"array"}}}'
```

maria: example of a broken response they saw:
```json
{"results":[{"name":"alpha"}]}
```

maria: expected response (what their integration expects):
```json
{"items":[{"name":"alpha"}]}
```

josh: thanks. confirm model version and quantization? did they pin anything?

maria: hosted default -> they did not pin. We rolled a quantization/adapter patch to the v2 build yesterday (Q4 q8a patch).

kevin: looking at runtime logs for that customer: saw repeated warnings: \"schema_transformer: unknown top-level key 'results' encountered; applying compatibility-wrapper\" followed by occasional json_parse_error downstream. The compatibility shim is kicking in only on a subset of outputs — seems length/edge-case dependent.

priya: on the ML side we changed the output mapping in the model manifest for some adapter paths to normalize to 'results' for legacy consumers; that was intended to be behind a flag but the flag default flipped on v2. Could explain the drift.

josh: can we get a temporary mitigation? Either make the parser tolerate both 'items' and 'results', or pin customer back to v1.

kevin: I can push a quick parser patch to accept alias keys (items <-> results) and add a regression test. Will also revert the manifest default for the hosted rollout. Pushing a small fix to parse layer now.

maria: letting the customer know and recommending pin to redwood/mistral-lite-7b-v1 until the fix is rolled.

eng-ml-oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1189 and assigned to kevin.

kevin: pushed parser patch to staging, adding tolerant key aliasing and a strict-mode toggle. Will roll to prod in next deploy window; adding tests to prevent reintroduction. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — customer pinned and acknowledged. Will monitor for further regressions. If it crops up again I'll reopen the ticket.

josh: filing internal postmortem checklist item: confirm model manifest flag behavior, add integration test for response_format=json_schema, and update release notes about schema-key mapping.

priya: noted — will include in the model onboarding checklist.
